name: mul
title: N-bit unsigned multiplier: p = a * b on 2N bits, without run-time arithmetic operators

banlist._comment: Yosys's alumacc merges + chains into the same $macc cell as *, so every arithmetic operator is banned at run time; constant arithmetic (parameters, genvar indices) stays allowed.

postsynth._comment: The checker's postsynth stage (README.md, `postsynth` in the task.json table): the fixed corners (130 vectors at N = 16), the harvested comparison constants and 200 seeded random vectors in FULL mode. Small because ls-sv's `run2` is slow on these multipliers: 120 ms per vector (both schedules) on the heap tree `mul_tree_h`, 130 ms on the array reference, 358 ms on `mul_wallace`, 500 ms on the 3076-process `mul_tree` (measured 10/30, one core), so the full stage takes 41 s, 44 s, 119 s and 166 s. The LIGHT mode (the local default) runs `light_vectors` = 40 of them (all-0, all-1, a few walking vectors, the first random ones): about 5 s on the array reference and 20 s on `mul_tree`, the slowest.

references.note: proved with the sv_comb tactics (sv_structure, sv_equations) and LeanModels.Sv.CombLib: the intended workflow, see PROVING.md
the same design (byte-identical to the first), proved with no tactic: the measured baseline of the proof effort

a log-depth carry-save TREE (the N partial-product rows are the leaves of a binary heap, the internal nodes are 4:2 compressors, two rows of 3:2 counters, or just pair two leaves; ripple final adder), parametric in N, proved with the sv_comb tactics (sv_structure, sv_equations) and the plain-Lean arithmetic in the file: see PROVING.md, section 8

a WALLACE tree as a tape of rows: one 2-D array holds the N partial products and a zero dummy row, carry-save adder g reads the three oldest live rows 3g, 3g+1, 3g+2 and appends its sum and carry rows (the queue form of Wallace's reduction by threes, N-1 adders of 3:2 counters); ripple final adder on the last two rows; parametric in N, proved with the sv_comb tactics (sv_structure, sv_equations) and the plain-Lean arithmetic in the file: see PROVING.md, section 9

a log-depth carry-save TREE whose H = ceil(N/2) leaves each hold TWO partial-product rows (a carry-save pair), every internal node a 4:2 compressor, ripple final adder; H is a `localparam integer H = (N + 1) / 2;`, which the sv_comb tactics read as one more named constant of N (PROVING.md, section 4); parametric in N, proved with the sv_comb tactics (sv_structure, sv_equations) and the plain-Lean arithmetic in the file: see PROVING.md, section 10
